depiction_rules.notes: An unnamed small group of ordinary ascetics appears only in D066 stanza 2, high in the sky as listeners. This is a scene-specific group contract, not a recurring identity.

visual_bible.hair: simple ascetic hair or restrained topknots
visual_bible.build: ordinary human proportions; one head and exactly two arms
visual_bible.clothing: simple muted cream or ochre ascetic robes
visual_bible.continuity_markers: small, distant witnesses separated from the foreground gopikas
